purpose: Resolve the four-name Ibn Kathir attribution cluster against a direct al-Tabari witness without collapsing the voices into one chain or adopting an authentication judgment.

ibn_kathir_witness.arabic_anchor: قال ابن عباس ومجاهد وسعيد بن جبير وقتادة نزلت في العاص بن وائل
ibn_kathir_witness.claim_scope: Each named voice is attributed the view that Quran 108:3 concerned al-As ibn Wa'il.

direct_tabari_witness.interface_locator: Verse 108:3 section, subsection beginning 'ذكر من قال ذلك', before the Uqba ibn Abi Mu'ayt alternative

voice_routes.route_anchor: حدثني محمد بن سعد قال ثني أبي قال ثني عمي قال ثني أبي عن أبيه عن ابن عباس
حدثنا ابن بشار قال ثنا عبد الرحمن قال ثنا سفيان عن هلال بن خباب قال سمعت سعيد بن جبير
جميعا عن ابن أبي نجيح عن مجاهد
حدثنا بشر قال ثنا يزيد قال ثنا سعيد عن قتادة

comparison.voice_handling: Preserve Ibn Abbas, Mujahid, Sa'id ibn Jubayr, and Qatada as four separately attributed voices. Ibn Kathir's compressed list is not a single isnad.
comparison.disagreement_context: This al-As ibn Wa'il identification remains one of several competing occasion/referent reports under verse 3 and is not promoted above the alternatives.

arabic_english_fidelity.policy: English may support the named-referent proposition only if the checked abridged entry contains an unambiguous al-As ibn Wa'il marker; it cannot supply the four Arabic route attributions unless those names are present.

explicit_disagreements_and_absences: The checked Ibn Kathir excerpt prints four names without their individual chains.
Al-Tabari supplies separate transmissions; they must not be merged into one route.
No claim is made that the four transmissions are mutually independent or equally authenticated.
The Ibn Ishaq to Yazid ibn Ruman report is route 108-I06-R02 and remains outside this bounded review.
Competing identifications—Uqba ibn Abi Mu'ayt, Ka'b ibn al-Ashraf with Quraysh, Abu Lahab, and Abu Jahl—remain explicit elsewhere in the staging set.
No database mutation or claim-count change is authorized.
next_step: Validate the live Arabic anchor, direct al-Tabari route anchors, and the bounded English marker; then review 108-I06-R02 separately.
